label: Aristotle, Physics VII.1, 242b30-243a1: Nothing, finite or infinite, goes through an infinite…
interpretation: Typed reading: nothing, finite or infinite, goes through an infinite motion in a finite time (ἀμφοτέρως δὲ ἀδύνατον). Aristotle relies here on Physics VI.7; the reading records only the impossibility claim, as a universal over things.
